page.layout: One page of text, one column; a margin note in the left margin beside "Alterum"; running head at top right; page number at top left.
page.running_head: De Agro Fris. inter Lavic. & Amsf.

main_text.p: libertatis patriæ contra Kenonem & omnes exteros propugnatio, collatis in eam subsidiis mutuis: & præter hanc quod quisque juris teneret, ejus conservatio, denique reddituum & locariorum familiæ Onsleniæ, quoad ea exul erit, in ærarium asscriptio. Fœdusali-ud.Alterum cum Humerziis, Langowoldiis, Fredowoldiis, asscriptis etiam Octopagicis Translavicanis, anno sequente ejectis jam Sciringiis, ipsis Nonis Iunii ictum in proximum decennium, & hoc quoque pro tuenda libertate, & jure patrio, conjuncta opera & opibus contra exteros Principes: in quo porrò cautum expresse ut oppidani eam urbis & finium suorum curam habeant, ne quid ex iis detrimenti sociis possit accidere: ut controversiis componendis arbitri a partibus designentur, qui nisi ante Trinitatis eas composuerint, eadem a conventu juridico omnium sociorum Groninga definiantur: ut conventus hujusmodi quotannis Groninga agatur statô die mense Iunio: nec exules Coppenus Iargaus, Iacobus Scelgius cum sociis recipientur: cætera de pace tenendâ de solvendis captivis, de pœnis cadium & injuriarum alia-rum

page.notes: The left margin note "Fœdusali-ud." is a catchword-style side note split across two lines, transcribed as one note. The final line "rum" is set flush right and completes "alia-rum". Some words are uncertain: "Largæus" reads as "Iargaus" in the scan, and "Sciringiis" and "Onsleniæ" could be misread. Roman and italic type alternate: the opening through "Principes:" is roman, the rest italic, as far as the scan shows.
